build_polyencoder_agent: build a PolyencoderAgent to rank candidates using a poly-encoder model with codes or n_first type
build_polyencoder_module: build a PolyEncoderModule with configurable attention types and learnable codes for context representation
score_candidates_polyencoder: score candidates against context using the PolyencoderAgent score_candidates method with encoded representations
encode_context_and_candidates: encode context tokens and candidate tokens independently using the PolyEncoderModule encode method
configure_polyencoder_attention: configure the polyencoder attention type as basic, sqrt, or multihead with adjustable number of heads
